class.name: SteamWorkshop
class.brief_description: Scoped Steam Workshop access from [method SteamClient.workshop].

method.name: item
method.description: Creates a reference to one item. Pass the canonical unsigned decimal published file ID. [method SteamWorkshopItemRef.fetch] validates the ID before using Steam.

method.name: legal_agreement_status
method.description: Use [code]await workshop.legal_agreement_status()[/code] for a [SteamWorkshopLegalAgreementStatusResult] for the exact active app. Check [member SteamWorkshopLegalAgreementStatus.needs_action] and offer [method show_legal_agreement] as an explicit player action when needed.

method.name: new_item
method.description: Creates a branchable draft for a new item. The draft remains local until [method SteamWorkshopPublishRequest.submit]. New items default to private visibility.

method.name: query
method.description: Creates a fresh query starting at the first page. Use the query methods to branch filters before calling [method SteamWorkshopQuery.fetch].

method.name: show_legal_agreement
method.description: Asks Steam to open the active app's Workshop legal agreement in its overlay. Call this in response to a player or author action. [constant OK] acknowledges the request. Query [method legal_agreement_status] after the user closes the overlay to read the current decision.

method.name: subscriptions
method.description: Copies up to [param limit] Workshop subscriptions for the signed-in user and current app in Steam's subscription order. Set [param include_locally_disabled] to include subscriptions disabled in the Steam client. The limit ranges from 1 to [constant MAX_SUBSCRIPTIONS]. Use a returned decimal ID with [method item] to inspect or install that item.

signal.name: install_changed
signal.description: Emitted for Steam's matching same-app installation or update event. [param published_id] identifies the item. Passive events provide a [code]null[/code] [param install]. Call [method SteamWorkshopItemRef.installed] to inspect its current directory when needed.

constants.constant: Maximum number of subscription IDs copied by one request.
